newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cricket - No live TV coverage of 2nd cricket test.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - No live TV coverage of 2nd cricket test.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Nov 26 - TV networks say the high cost and difficulty of getting cricket coverage from Pakistan means Kiwis won't see the second test live, NZPA reports.
New Zealand beat Pakistan at the weekend and the second test starts on Thursday.
Sky sports channel scheduler Steve Bicknell said there was no English commentary available for the five-day test, but the channel would have live coverage of the one-day matches in December.
